entities.name: Kwŏn Yul
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kwŏn Yul was a Korean army general and the commander-in-chief of the Joseon period, who successfully led the Korean forces against Japan during the Japanese invasions of Korea. He is best known for the Battle of Haengju where he defeated an attacking force of about 30,000 Japanese with 2,800 troops.
